responsibility: Implements the RTL hard-register renaming optimization pass that rewrites def-use chains to alternative hard registers after allocation. It builds local and cross-basic-block chains, records chain conflicts and call clobbering, computes candidate renaming classes and registers, applies selected renamings to maximize register-file usage and reduce dependence chains, and exports operand/chain analysis infrastructure for callers that need detailed renaming information. The pass operates semi-locally on already-allocated hard-register code.
same_name_distinction: This is the register-renaming pass implementation: it builds and analyzes chains, chooses replacement hard registers, applies renamings, and defines the pass. The same-stem header gcc/regrename.h provides the shared chain/operand data structures and exported analysis/transformation declarations used by callers.
